response.sql:
WITH per_telescope_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_average
  FROM per_telescope_avg
),
filtered_and_calculated AS (
  SELECT 
    pta.telescref,
    pta.avg_modindex,
    pta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_average AS diff_from_overall,
    pta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_average AS ratio
  FROM per_telescope_avg pta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  telescref,
  avg_modindex,
  diff_from_overall,
  ratio
FROM filtered_and_calculated
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in modindex are ignored when computing per-telescope averages (standard SQL aggregate behavior).
The overall average is the mean of per-telescope averages (equal weight per telescope), not the mean of all individual modindex values.
